title: Porting the ThinkPad X61 to Coreboot
summary: A detailed technical guide on porting Coreboot open-source firmware to the ThinkPad X61, replacing the proprietary BIOS with free software firmware that provides greater security, control, and extend device longevity.
problem_solved: Replaces proprietary closed-source BIOS on the ThinkPad X61 with open-source Coreboot firmware, giving users full control over their hardware's lowest-level software.
why_valuable: Enables users to eliminate proprietary firmware blobs, improve security through transparency, and extend the functional life of older hardware through free software.
